jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ONE isolated cutout bone-part for a 2D game puppet, not a complete character.
Reference image 1 is the approved identity/style source. Extract or redraw ONLY the requested existing body part; preserve its exact yellow/cream colors, ink line and hatching, right-facing orientation.
THE ONLY OBJECT TO DRAW: 本次只画奶龙平静头颈，含不等高小角；预留眼和口鼻，不烘焙五官；只交这一独立单元，不画其他零件、对照姿、sheet、文字或背景。保持主表指定造型、朝向与挂点。
Neighboring anatomy must be absent. A torso has NO arms, NO legs, NO feet, NO tail, NO neck or head; cap joints with a tiny overlap. A head-neck part has NO body, arms or limbs; keep blank yellow face surface if eyes/mouth are separate. Eye groups contain eyes ONLY, transparent between them, no face-shaped skin plate. A mouth piece has the mouth/muzzle ONLY, no head/eyes/neck. Arms include only shoulder-to-hand, feet only ankle-and-foot, tail only tail.
Fill the center 60% of a square 1024x1024 transparent canvas with this SINGLE part, leaving 15% clear margin on all sides, not in its original full-body position. Opaque painted part, genuine alpha outside. No floor shadow, glow, alignment crosses, typography, sheet, extra parts or whole animal.
jobs.runtimeProcess: Alpha-bounds crop and proportional downsample only; original image preserved unchanged.

Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: preserve its original grotesque ink hatching, matte muted painted fill and coarse uneven outlines. Do not depict the employee or copy his pose.
Subject: N05 咕咕嘎嘎 平静定稿. 本次只画一只完整平静 咕咕嘎嘎，严格采用本行具体形状与三色群，不含动作对照或其他角色；只交这一独立单元，不画其他零件、对照姿、sheet、文字或背景。保持主表指定造型、朝向与挂点。
原创怪诞手绘收容风：不均匀粗墨外轮廓、较细结构线、局部不对称、平涂和少量排线；轮廓在游戏缩小尺寸仍清楚。 冷灰蓝企鹅轮廓，梨形大身、略小的偏头，旧纸白不对称腹面和脸块；不等大眼、小角形喙、短鳍、滑稽宽扁双足。灰青围巾两端长短不一；深体 #394950、淡腹 #d9d8c4、围巾 #7faaa9。不要礼帽、可爱红领结或写实羽毛。 侧视略带正脸可读性，所有部位围绕单一脚底根节点，不画房间。
Composition: full body, right facing side view with slightly visible front face, feet on a common baseline near 88% canvas height, generous transparent margin; no ground shadow. Canvas requested: 1024 × 1024 px.
Avoid: 不要照片、3D 渲染、像素风、光滑矢量图标风或高饱和日漫；不要复制现成游戏的角色、脸型或官方 IP 素材；不要背景、文字、水印、UI、血条、黄色选中圈或攻击范围；不要以红色滤镜代替形变。 No typography, no staff, no environment, no multi-panel sheet. Real alpha transparency, not a checkerboard painted into pixels.
